papers.title: Distributed Graph Algorithms for Communication-Efficient Networked Systems
papers.abstract: Develops efficient algorithms for computing graph properties in communication-constrained distributed networks, with applications to sensor networks and autonomous swarms.

papers.title: Fast Spanning Tree Construction in the CONGEST Model
papers.abstract: Analyzes optimal round complexity for constructing spanning trees in networks with restricted message sizes. Proves O(D log n) upper bound.

papers.title: Approximation Algorithms for Dynamic Network Coverage
papers.abstract: Proposes 1.5-approximation algorithm for k-center facility location with time-varying demand in military logistics networks.

papers.title: Robustness of Breadth-First Search in Adversarial Graphs
papers.abstract: Analyzes BFS performance when nodes/edges are dynamically removed by adversary. Proves poly-time approximation guarantees for tree construction.

papers.title: Polynomial-Time Algorithms for Planar Graph Decomposition
papers.abstract: Develops O(D²)-round distributed algorithm for finding balanced separators in planar graphs using spanning tree techniques.
